question: Ghiyasuddin Balban (1265-1286 AD), ruler of the Slave dynasty, took up the title of __ __.
solution:
The correct answer is __**Zil-Ilahi (Shadow of God)**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• Ghiyas-ud-din Balban was the first Muslim ruler to formulate the ‘theory of kingship’ similar to the ‘theory of the divine right of the kings'.
 
• Balban lived and ruled from 1266 AD to 1287 AD.
